role.name: MR:RES:EntraTest:DirectoryRole
role.description: Metarole of the Entra Role roles whose holders are managed from midPoint. Order 2: every user holding the role gets a tenant-wide Entra directory role assignment for their Entra account. There is no order-1 construction: directory roles are built into Entra, cannot be created or deleted, and stay linked to the shadow made by the import. Assigned only to explicitly chosen roles, never to all Entra Role roles.

inducement.description: Users holding the Entra Role role get the directory role assignment in Entra.

outbound.name: entra-test-directory-role-assignment
outbound.description: Assigns the user's Entra account the directory role linked to the role the user holds.
